What 'Documented Buying' Means at Our Counter

Plenty of shops will take your gold with no questions and no paperwork — and that should worry you, not comfort you. An undocumented sale leaves you with no proof of what you sold or what you were paid, and it is how stolen or disputed jewellery moves through the market. A professional cash for gold dealer runs the opposite process, and ours is fixed: (1) your identity is recorded through digital KYC (photo ID; PAN for transactions of ₹2 lakh and above, as regulations require); (2) your gold is tested on a German XRF Karatmeter with the reading shown to you; (3) the valuation — weight, purity, live rate — is calculated openly; and (4) you are paid by cash, NEFT or RTGS against a proper invoice that itemises the transaction.

An Established Store, Not a Pop-Up Buyer

We buy from a fixed address — Shop GF-04, Gaur City Centre, Gaur Chowk, Sector 4, Greater Noida West — inside a staffed commercial complex, with published timings (7 days, 10 AM – 8 PM), a published phone number and this website carrying our full name and address. That permanence is itself a credential: a dealer who intends to be at the same counter next year cannot afford the tricks a temporary buyer can. Our valuers are trained on the XRF equipment and the 4Cs for diamonds, and the same documented process applies whether you sell one ring or a full family collection.

Dealer vs Local Jeweller vs Online Buyer

  • Dedicated gold dealer (us): buying is the whole business — XRF testing in front of you, live-rate valuation, instant documented payment, no purchase condition.
  • Local jeweller: buying is a side activity to selling jewellery; valuations often route through acid testing and deductions, and exchange is pushed over cash.
  • Online / mail-in buyers: you surrender possession before the final figure is fixed — the valuation happens out of your sight, and rejecting it means waiting for your gold to come back.
